words.gloss_range: connective or resumptive particle linking the clause to the prior replacement claim
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as connection, not as a fresh topic. It carries the removal-and-replacement claim from 35:16 into the negated evaluation of 35:17, so the reader hears the verse as an evaluative seal on the prior scenario rather than as a later event. Its tiny prefixed form is light on the surface but clause-level in effect: the first sign already makes the non-difficulty claim dependent on what came before.

topics.headline: connected evaluative closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 35:17 is attached to 35:16 as a judgment on the replacement scenario, not introduced as an unrelated assertion.
topics.reason: The clause is a single negated nominal clause, and the following demonstrative is explicitly resolved to the removal-and-replacement proposition in 35:16; this supports the connective-resumptive force.

topics.headline: first particle carries the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah's first written sign already marks dependency on the previous ayah before any noun or predicate appears.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a coordinating or resumptive particle, and the full clause remains syntactically tied to the prior referent.

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) negates the whole relation, not just the last adjective. The denied claim is that the matter gathered by {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) could count as difficult with respect to {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}). Because it later pairs with the predicate {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), the negation is strengthened: difficulty receives no foothold, rather than one specified obstacle being ruled out.

topics.headline: negation covers the whole relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what is cancelled is the whole idea of difficulty measured against God, not merely a final adjective taken in isolation.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the ayah as one negated nominal clause with the predicate attached to the demonstrative subject.

topics.headline: separated negation frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negation opens at {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) and closes through {{ar:بِعَزِيزٍ}} ({{tr:bi-ʿazīzin}}), making the denial broader than a casual negation.
topics.reason: The guardrail explicitly treats the predicate particle as part of the negated predicate construction, not as a separate lexical instrument.

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative functioning as the subject and compressing the prior removal-and-replacement proposition
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) is the subject of the verbless clause, but it does not point to a nearby object. It gathers the removal-and-replacement scenario from 35:16 into one evaluable matter. Its distance lets the verse move from direct threat to measured proposition: first the matter, then {{ar:عَلَى ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:ʿalā Allāhi}}), and only then the denied predicate.

topics.headline: prior scenario compressed as subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demonstrative packages several actions from 35:16 into one subject for evaluation.
topics.reason: The attachment guardrail strongly resolves the demonstrative to the preceding removal-and-replacement proposition, matching the CRITICAL compression claim.

topics.headline: from direct threat to measured proposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the register shift from addressed humans in 35:16 to an impersonal matter weighed before God in 35:17.
topics.reason: The local order places the demonstrative subject before the divine measure and predicate, while the cross-reference keeps the referent anchored in the prior ayah.

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) is the measuring preposition of the clause. It governs {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}), so the question is not difficulty in the abstract but whether the prior replacement could be a burden or resistant measure upon God. Its placement before {{ar:بِعَزِيزٍ}} ({{tr:bi-ʿazīzin}}) makes the divine standard arrive before the word of difficulty is heard.

topics.headline: difficulty measured upon God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that difficulty is denied specifically as a burden or evaluative measure upon God, not as an abstract property.
topics.reason: The preposition syntactically governs the divine name and the QAC grammar identifies it as marking burden, standard, or evaluative bearing.

topics.headline: measure phrase intervenes before predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause pauses on the divine measure before allowing the final adjective of resistance to arrive.
topics.reason: Local order places the prepositional measure between the demonstrative subject and the particle-marked predicate.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) is not the grammatical subject; it is the governed complement in {{ar:عَلَى ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:ʿalā Allāhi}}). That makes the named divine reality the standard by which the prior replacement is measured, while {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) remains the matter under judgment. The proper name also blocks a generic deity reading. Root-family and derivational notes can sharpen the sense of worship, refuge, and dependence around the name, but the local force is the lexicalized proper name placed at the clause's central hinge. The documented 68-cooccurrence pressure between divine-name language and the ʿ-z-z field, including same-surah anchors (35:2, 35:10, 35:28) and the replacement formula (14:19-20), is present as a narrowed field pressure: here it does not turn {{ar:عَزِيزٍ}} ({{tr:ʿazīzin}}) into a divine epithet, but places denied resistance inside a known divine-might environment.

topics.headline: proper name as governed standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine name is given as the measure of capacity while the demonstrative remains the evaluated subject.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the divine name as the complement of {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}), and the predicate relation remains attached to the demonstrative.

topics.headline: lexicalized name, not generic deity term
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause rests on the named divine identity, while etymological and root-family pressures remain subordinate to the proper name.
topics.reason: The proper noun analysis is strong locally, while the missing V4 root means no dictionary guardrail can license expanded etymological activation beyond bounded coloring.

topics.headline: divine name and ʿ-z-z field pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the name stands in a familiar divine-might field, but this occurrence uses that field to deny resistance of the act rather than to state a divine epithet.
topics.reason: The cooccurrence and same-surah anchors support field pressure, but local syntax separates the proper name from the final adjective by predicative negation.

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the predicate particle attached to {{ar:عَزِيزٍ}} ({{tr:ʿazīzin}}), not an instrument. It gives the adjective its formal genitive shape while serving the negated predicate construction. Because this particle arrives only after {{ar:عَلَى ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:ʿalā Allāhi}}), the clause first establishes the divine measure and then completes the strengthened denial at the final adjective.

topics.headline: predicate particle strengthens denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) marks and tightens the negated predicate instead of adding a separate instrumental meaning.
topics.reason: The translation support explicitly warns against lexicalizing the particle twice and treats it as part of the negated predicate construction.

topics.headline: delayed completion of the negative frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negative frame stretches across the clause, so difficulty appears only after the subject and divine measure have already been heard.
topics.reason: The local order separates the negator from the particle-marked predicate, with the divine measure intervening before the final predicate.

words.gloss_range: indefinite particle-marked predicate denying difficulty, resistance, inaccessibility, or inviolability of the prior replacement upon God
words.root_gloss_range: broad ʿ-z-z range includes might, honor, overcoming, inaccessibility, reinforcement, and difficulty; the local predicate selects the difficulty/resistance/inviolability pressure and denies it, while remote branches are not locally activated

words.prose: {{ar:عَزِيزٍۢ}} ({{tr:ʿazīzin}}) is the final predicate, not an adjective modifying {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}). Its genitive form comes from the prefixed {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), while its clause role remains predicative toward {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}). Because it is indefinite inside the {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) plus {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) frame, the clause denies any instance or degree of resistant difficulty. The ʿ-z-z field contributes hardness, inaccessibility, might, and inviolability, but local grammar narrows that field to what can be predicated of the prior replacement and then negated: the act is not hard, inaccessible, rare, or inviolable upon God. The familiar divine-might association is inverted, with contrasts such as social inviolability denied in 11:91, owned might in 35:10, the replacement formula in 14:19-20, and later divine naming in 35:28. As the ayah's closing word, the sound and indefinite ending let firmness arrive audibly at the same point where the grammar cancels firmness as a property of the act.

topics.headline: predicate relation protected
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:عَزِيزٍ}} ({{tr:ʿazīzin}}) judges the prior matter as predicate, rather than describing the divine name as an adjective.
topics.reason: The guardrail makes the particle-marked adjective the predicate of the demonstrative, while the divine name is separately governed by {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}).

topics.headline: no instance of difficulty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the indefinite predicate under strengthened negation denies any kind, instance, or degree of the resistant quality.
topics.reason: The construction combines an indefinite predicate with the negation-strengthening particle, supporting a broad denial rather than a narrow obstacle.

topics.headline: root hardness and inviolability denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word carries more than plain difficulty: hardness, inaccessibility, rarity, and inviolability are evoked only to be denied upon God.
topics.reason: V4 confirms broad accepted ʿ-z-z branches, but local predication and negation restrict the active payoff to resistance, difficulty, inaccessibility, and inviolability as denied qualities, not to every branch in the root family.

topics.headline: familiar epithet field inverted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a word often associated with might is used here to name what replacement is not upon God, with contrasts across 11:91, 14:19-20, 35:10, and 35:28.
topics.reason: The intertextual and distributional pressure is coherent, but local syntax makes the adjective an indefinite negated predicate of the act rather than a direct divine epithet.

topics.headline: firmness heard at the cancelled closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final sound texture lets the feel of firmness land exactly where the grammar denies firmness or resistance.
topics.reason: The final word position, doubled consonantal root texture, and indefinite ending all align with the semantic cancellation in the negated predicate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated predicate at word 5 evaluates the deictically indicated matter in relation to God.
baseline_models.mechanism: The severe-impact branch of ع ز ز makes the clause a direct denial that the indicated matter imposes difficulty, weight, or strain on God.

activation_trace.role: Severe impact and difficulty supply the burden-like predicate that the focus negates.

changed_reading.before: The focus merely evaluates an unresolved matter.
changed_reading.after: The indicated matter cannot impose difficulty or severe burden on God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same negated word-5 predicate can describe what is rare, inaccessible, or hard to obtain.
baseline_models.mechanism: The rarity branch shifts the clause from effort alone to reachability: whatever the deictic points to is not beyond divine access or realization.

activation_trace.role: Rarity and hard attainability make the denied property one of inaccessibility, not only strenuous performance.

changed_reading.before: The matter may simply be hard to perform.
changed_reading.after: The matter is neither rare, inaccessible, nor beyond realization for God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prepositional relation to God allows the word-5 predicate to be heard as a would-be pressure or prevailing force whose success is denied.
baseline_models.mechanism: Branches of ع ز ز involving conquest and an affair, illness, or death gaining the upper hand recast difficulty as domination: the indicated matter never becomes master of the divine agent.

activation_trace.role: Overcoming and subjugation supply the adversarial relation whose success the negation blocks.
An illness, death, or affair prevailing over a person supplies a more specific image of a matter gaining mastery, here denied of God.

changed_reading.before: The indicated act might demand unusual effort.
changed_reading.after: No indicated affair can prevail over, corner, or master God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening creation sequence combines expandable creation, willing, and capacity that reaches action. This turns the focus from a local denial of strain into a claim that generative complexity never approaches a divine capacity ceiling.

activation_trace.role: Difficulty and severe impact provide the focus predicate whose scope is expanded by the creation sequence.
Increase and growth make created configuration expandable rather than fixed.
Innovative bringing-into-being supplies the generative domain in which difficulty is denied.
Will directed toward a thing supplies selection of what the generative capacity realizes.
Effective capacity that reaches action converts the denial of difficulty into executable power.

structural_cues: 35:1 closes a creation-and-increase sequence with an unrestricted capacity predication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies increase, origination, willing, and effective capacity; I infer that their conjunction removes any fixed complexity ceiling, while the narrower alternative is merely that one indicated act is easy.

changed_reading.before: One unresolved matter is not difficult for God.
changed_reading.after: Expansion and variation within creation do not accumulate into a limit on divine effective capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root that is negated of the focus matter is positively predicated of God amid unilateral opening, holding, releasing, raising, and bringing schemes to ruin. The issue is therefore not just task difficulty but an asymmetry: strength belongs to the agent and no counter-strength inheres in the task.

activation_trace.role: Difficulty is the ordinary focus value that the repeated positive divine title reorients.
Conquest and subjugation expose the latent question of which side can prevail.
Opening a closure supplies one side of unilateral control over access.
Holding and detaining supply the counter-operation to opening and release.
Sending and release complete the controllable gate sequence.
Strength, inviolability, and honor are positively located in God immediately after the control sequence.
The repeated strength-and-honor sense is totalized as belonging to God, sharpening the lexical reversal in the focus.
Raising supplies an effective upward outcome under divine control.
Ruin and corruption supply the failed outcome of a rival scheme rather than a successful counter-force.

structural_cues: 35:2 ends its open-hold-release sequence with the divine title from the focus root, and 35:10 repeats that root twice while assigning its totality to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared root, positive divine predication, total attribution, and unilateral control operations; I infer an agent-versus-task asymmetry, while the live alternative is that the title and the focus adjective retain unrelated conventional senses.

changed_reading.before: The focus says only that a task is not hard.
changed_reading.after: Because strength and prevailing agency are wholly on God's side, the indicated matter has no counter-strength by which it could become hard for Him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dead-land sequence supplies a visible reversal from loss of life to renewed life and spreading revival. Coupled with the focus branch in which death or an affair can gain mastery over a person, the negation can mean that death never becomes a prevailing state for God to confront helplessly.

activation_trace.role: An affair, illness, or death gaining mastery supplies the focus-side state that is denied.
Loss of life and force supplies the apparently terminal state from which the sequence begins.
Earth becoming alive through rain and growth supplies the concrete reversal of that terminal state.
Reviving the dead after death names the reversal's larger horizon.

structural_cues: 35:9 forms a causal progression from atmospheric movement through dead land to life and then points from that process to revival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a death-to-life reversal and a focus branch for death or an affair prevailing; I infer that this process can fill the focus deictic, while the live alternative is that it serves resurrection alone rather than the nearby replacement of humanity.

changed_reading.after: Crossing the boundary from death to renewed life is not a state reversal over which death can prevail against God.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier verse evaluates another deictically marked complex of creation and life-course detail with the positive predicate of ease. Its nearly identical relational frame strongly glosses the focus's negated difficulty branch without eliminating the live inaccessibility and conquest shades.

activation_trace.role: Difficulty and severe impact provide the negative predicate matched by the earlier positive ease predicate.
Origination places the parallel ease judgment in the same broad creative domain as the focus.
Openness and ease after hardship provide the positive counterpart to the focus's denial of difficulty.

structural_cues: 35:11 and 35:17 use matching deictic evaluation frames with the same relation to God but opposite ease/difficulty formulations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a near-parallel frame and an explicit ease branch; I infer that the clauses mutually gloss one another, while the alternative is that 35:11 restricts ease to its enumerated life processes and leaves the focus semantically broader.

changed_reading.before: The focus can range among difficulty, rarity, and overpowering.
changed_reading.after: Its strongest local control is positive ease, especially for intricate processes of bringing life into ordered existence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence opposes human need to divine self-sufficiency, then runs from will through removal to the arrival of newly originated creation. The focus consequently evaluates replacement as dependency-free execution, not as an isolated feat of force.

activation_trace.role: Difficulty supplies the evaluation attached to the immediately preceding replacement sequence.
Need and lack of means locate dependency on the human side of the contrast.
Wealth and self-sufficiency locate freedom from dependency on the divine side.
Will directed to an object initiates the conditional replacement sequence.
Going away and removal supply the displacement of the present population.
Coming and bringing supply the arrival side of replacement.
Fresh origination prevents replacement from meaning mere relocation of an existing stock.
New occurrence after a break supplies discontinuity between the removed and incoming creation.

structural_cues: 35:15-17 forms a dependency contrast followed by a conditional removal-and-replacement sequence and then the focus evaluation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human need, divine self-sufficiency, will, removal, arrival, origination, and newness; I infer that self-sufficiency enables replacement without resource dependence, while the alternative is a narrower assertion of sovereign choice alone.

changed_reading.before: The focus deictic has no settled referent.
changed_reading.after: Removing dependent humanity and originating a genuinely new creation requires no borrowed means, retained substrate, or strain for God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verse immediately after the focus makes personal burden heavy yet nontransferable, even through a call for help. This prevents easy replacement of creation from collapsing into moral fungibility: ontological replacement is effortless, but liability is not carried from one self to another.

activation_trace.role: Difficulty and weight in the focus invite comparison with the explicit load mechanics that follow.
A heavy burden supplies the individualized liability whose transfer is denied.
Weight opposed to lightness makes the human burden contrast materially explicit.
Bearing a visible load supplies the transfer operation repeatedly refused in the next verse.

structural_cues: The focus is followed immediately by repeated burden and carrying language with categorical transfer negation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies effortless divine replacement followed by nontransferable human load; I infer a boundary between replacing persons as creatures and transferring their liabilities, while the alternative is that the two adjacent claims are not meant to constrain one another.

changed_reading.before: Effortless replacement could make persons sound wholly interchangeable.
changed_reading.after: Creation can be replaced without difficulty, yet each person's acquired burden remains nonexchangeable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later creation scenes repeatedly foreground divergence of colors and kinds, then again predicate strength of God. The new creation near the focus can therefore be heard as freely differentiated reconfiguration rather than production of an undifferentiated substitute.

activation_trace.role: Rarity and difficult attainability frame whether novel differentiated forms are beyond reach.
Taking different paths supplies divergence rather than repetition within created output.
Kind or type turns visible color variation into categorical differentiation.
A second divergence occurrence extends differentiated output across living beings.
Kinds and types make the second variation sequence structurally comparable to the first.
Strength and inviolability return as a divine predicate after the differentiated creation display.

structural_cues: 35:27-28 repeats a difference-and-color pattern across fruits, mountains, people, moving creatures, and livestock before returning to the focus root as a divine title.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated differentiated creation and a returning divine title; I infer that this display concretizes the nearby new creation, while the alternative is that it functions only as a sign of knowledge and fear rather than replacement capacity.

changed_reading.before: A new creation could mean a simple one-for-one substitute.
changed_reading.after: Even genuinely differentiated and variously configured creation is neither rare nor inaccessible to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate antecedent makes created beings replaceable, whereas 35:43 categorically denies substitution and diversion of the divine way. The focus thus marks an asymmetry of objects: replacing creation is easy for God, but created agents cannot replace or redirect the governing pattern.

activation_trace.role: Difficulty supplies the modal evaluation whose object must be kept distinct from the governing pattern.
Fresh origination supplies the replaceable object on the creature side.
New occurrence after a break establishes actual discontinuity in the replacement.
A running, followed way supplies the stable governing order on the other side of the contrast.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the substitution categorically denied of that order.
A thing shifting from its state supplies the redirection categorically denied alongside substitution.

structural_cues: The surah places an affirmative creature-replacement clause immediately before the focus and later pairs two categorical non-change clauses about the divine way.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies new creation on one side and a way admitting neither substitution nor diversion on the other; I infer a deliberate asymmetry between replaceable governed beings and an unreplaceable governing pattern, while the alternative is that the two claims answer unrelated local arguments.

changed_reading.before: The focus might imply a flat world in which everything is equally replaceable.
changed_reading.after: God can replace creation without difficulty, while creation cannot substitute for or divert His governing pattern.

context_deltas.mechanism: The historical comparison in 35:44 places greater created strength against an explicit denial that anything can produce divine incapacity, then closes with effective capacity. This strongly activates the focus's conquest branch: difficult means capable of thwarting or escaping, not merely laborious.

activation_trace.role: Overcoming and subjugation provide the adversarial sense clarified by the later incapacity denial.
Intense force and solidity quantify the superior created opposition that still fails.
Strength gathered like strands of a rope supplies the cumulative force of the would-be rival.
Weakness and inability name the failed effect that no thing can impose on God.
Outstripping and escaping pursuit supply the alternate way a resistant object might thwart agency, also denied.
Capacity reaching effective action closes the opposition between created force and divine execution.

structural_cues: 35:44 sets historically greater created force against an unrestricted negation of divine incapacity and closes with effective capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accumulated created strength, inability or escape, and effective capacity; I infer that 35:44 functions as a semantic expansion of the focus's conquest branch, while the alternative is a general theological restatement rather than a lexical gloss.

changed_reading.before: The indicated matter might simply require no great effort.
changed_reading.after: No concentration of created strength can thwart, outstrip, or render God unable to execute the indicated replacement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing counterfactual says immediate taking for acquired acts would leave no creature, yet action is postponed to a fixed term. The focus is therefore modal rather than predictive: lack of present execution signals chosen timing, not difficulty or inability.

activation_trace.role: Difficulty is the explanation for non-action that the closing delay sequence rules out.
Taking to account for fault supplies the executable action considered counterfactually.
Acquiring gain through action supplies the human conduct on which taking would be based.
Leaving or relinquishing supplies the counterfactual remainder, here reduced to none.
Postponement to a later time explicitly replaces inability as the reason action has not occurred.
A prescribed temporal endpoint supplies the chosen boundary of delay.

structural_cues: 35:45 combines a counterfactual immediate taking, an explicit postponement, and a twice-marked terminal time.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a devastating executable counterfactual and explicit postponement to a term; I infer an ability-versus-timing distinction, while the live alternative emphasizes forbearance without treating the verse as a control on the focus's modality.

changed_reading.before: If replacement or judgment is not difficult, immediate execution might seem expected.
changed_reading.after: The act is fully within divine capacity, but its occurrence remains governed by chosen timing rather than compelled immediacy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a material-hardness branch rather than the ordinary abstract adjective. It remains anchored in the exact focus root and in 35:41's hold-versus-displacement mechanics; downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for nonresistance, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 5 can activate the branch of hard ground and cohesive matter under negation.

activation_trace.role: Hard ground and material cohesion supply a physical-resistance image for the negated predicate.
Holding and detaining make cosmic stability an actively maintained condition rather than autonomous solidity.
Departure from place or state supplies the displacement that held structures do not independently resist.
Exhaustive negation removes every alternate holder and isolates the source of cohesion.

changed_reading.before: The indicated matter is abstractly not difficult.
changed_reading.after: No created configuration is materially hard, cohesive, or immovable against God; its stability is held rather than self-secured.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries a constricted-yield animal image into an abstract divine predicate. It remains anchored through the focus branch and a coherent opening, holding, and flowing-yield network in 35:2; downstream prose should label it an exploratory throughput analogy and never imply that the source-domain physiology is itself asserted of God.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 5 has a branch for constricted output and scant yield obtainable only with effort.

activation_trace.role: A constricted outlet and scant yield requiring effort supply the bottleneck image denied by the focus.
Opening a closure supplies release from constricted access.
Holding back supplies the opposed state in the flow-control mechanism.
Successive milk or yield preserves the literal throughput source domain while linking it to release.

changed_reading.before: The matter is generally difficult or inaccessible.
changed_reading.after: Divine opening, giving, and replacement are not bottlenecked by a narrow channel or an output extractable only through effort.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it moves from the adjective to a derivationally related reinforcement branch. It remains anchored in the focus root and in later denials of any alternate cosmic holder or capacity-defeating force; downstream prose should qualify it as an auxiliary-power resonance, not a grammatical paraphrase of the focus word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 5 can remotely activate strengthening one agent by adding another.

activation_trace.role: Reinforcement by making one party strong with another supplies the auxiliary requirement that the outlier denies.
Holding the cosmic order supplies the operation for which no successor can substitute.
Exhaustive negation excludes every possible auxiliary holder.
Strength compounded like rope strands supplies the strongest available image of aggregated created assistance or resistance.
Inability names the deficit that auxiliary reinforcement would remedy, but which the context denies.

changed_reading.before: The act is not difficult for God acting with unspecified means.
changed_reading.after: The act does not require a co-agent, reserve force, or reinforcing addition to make divine agency sufficient.

strongest_changes: The repeated root creates an asymmetry: God is positively characterized by strength while the task is denied any strength capable of resisting Him.
The close syntactic parallel in 35:11 strongly controls the primary reading toward positive ease without erasing rarity and conquest resonances.
35:15-18 identifies effortless replacement of dependent creation while immediately preserving nontransferable personal accountability.
35:43-45 distinguish replaceable creatures from an unreplaceable governing pattern, deny every capacity-defeating force, and separate delayed action from inability.
summary.what_was_special: A very short focus clause became a hinge among ease, access, prevailing force, replacement, and restraint. The most distinctive activations came from the positive/negative reuse of ع ز ز and from concrete branch networks of cohesion, flow, and reinforcement that remain viable only as explicitly contained analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: The scope of the focus deictic may be limited to immediate human replacement or may also gather earlier creation and revival processes.
The ease parallel may dominate the lexical reading completely, or conquest and inaccessibility may remain deliberate secondary resonances.
The cohesion, bottleneck, and reinforcement models are well anchored but remain branch-distant analogies rather than secure contextual senses.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir olayın, kaybın veya yapılacak işin kişi üzerinde büyük ve ağır bir etki yaratmasını; bu nedenle güç, çetin veya katlanılması zor gelmesini destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel bir zorluk adı değil, belirli bir şeyin kişiye ağır ve çetin gelmesini bildiren bağımlı yapıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam kişi üzerinde etki bildiren belirli eylem yapılarıyla sınırlıdır; yalın biçime genel zorluk anlamı aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir olayın, durumun veya yapılacak işin kişi üzerinde büyük bir ağırlık yaratması ve ona çetin, zor ya da katlanılması güç gelmesi.

facets.statement: Bir durum veya eylem, onu yaşayan kişi için zor ve ağır hale gelir.
Başkasının uğradığı olayın kişiye büyük ve sarsıcı gelmesi bu etkinin özel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir şeyin kişiye zor, ağır ve büyük gelmesi noktasında birleşir; başkasının başına gelen olaydan etkilenme bunun özel bağlamıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir olayın veya yapılacak işin özne üzerindeki zorlayıcı ve büyük etkisini anlatan yapıya uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişisel etkiyi, zorluğu ve olayın büyük ağırlığını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.text: başına gelen bana çok ağır geldi
contextual_glosses.applicability: Başka bir kişinin uğradığı olayın konuşan üzerinde büyük ve zorlayıcı etki yarattığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Etkilenen kişiyi, başkasının yaşadığı olayı ve ağırlık derecesini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bu bana zor, ağır ve çetin geldi
başına gelen bana çok büyük ve ağır geldi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli olayın veya işin bir kişiye ağır gelmesi ve onda yarattığı etki yapısal olarak gereklidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Zorluk, belirli bir etkilenen kişi belirtilmeden işin veya günün genel niteliği olabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kolay olmayan, çetin ve güç bir durumu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak zorluğu yaşayan kişiye bağlar; komşu ise zorluğu olayın veya işin kendi niteliği olarak daha genel biçimde sunar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyin öznel olarak ağır, büyük ve zor gelmesi yeterlidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yükün sahibini bastırması, ona üstün gelmesi ve giderek ağırlaşması öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kişinin bir olayın ağırlığı altında zorlanmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak algılanan zorluk ve etkiyi, komşu ise ağırlığın kişiyi bastıracak ölçüde üstün gelmesini temel alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin çekirdeği dişi deve veya keçinin meme kanalının darlığı yüzünden sütünün az gelmesi ya da ancak güçlükle sağılmasıdır. Varlıklı ama cimri kişiye ilişkin söz, hayvan niteliğinin benzetmeli ve kalıba bağlı kullanımından ibarettir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: İnsan cimriliği çekirdeğe katılmaz; yalnızca belirtilen atasözü benzeri kalıpta bağımlı bir kullanım olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hayvanın niteliğini bildiren biçim ile varlıklı cimriyi anlatan kalıp ayrıdır; kalıptaki insan anlamı yalın biçime genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Dişi deve veya keçinin meme kanalının dar olması nedeniyle sütünün az gelmesi ya da ancak zor ve uğraştırıcı bir sağımla akması.

facets.statement: Dar meme kanalı süt akışını azaltır ve sağımı güçleştirir.
Sütü çok olduğu halde zor veren hayvan imgesi, yalnızca kalıp sözde varlıklı fakat cimri kişiyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dar meme kanalı, az süt akışı ve zahmetli sağım ilişkisinde birleşir; cimri varlıklı kişi benzetmesi yalnızca özel kalıpta geçerlidir.

concept_gloss.text: dar kanallı ve güç sağılan olma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dişi deve veya keçide kanal darlığına bağlı az ya da zahmetli süt akışını anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Anatomik darlığı, az süt akışını ve sağım güçlüğünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sadece bol varlığı olduğu halde vermekte direnen kişiyi hayvana benzeten kalıp söz için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Varlık bolluğu ile vermeme ve cimrilik karşıtlığını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: meme kanalı dar, sütü az veya güç sağılan dişi hayvan
malı çok olduğu halde vermeyen cimri kişi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Süt azlığı dar meme kanalından doğar ve sağımın emek istemesiyle birlikte tanımlanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sütün bütünüyle kesilmesi veya azlığı yanında yağmur kıtlığı da kapsama girer.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: güç süt verme ve sütün kesilmesi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal süt veriminin az veya yetersiz olması alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak anatomik daralma yüzünden sütün zor çıkmasını, komşu ise nedeni bundan bağımsız olabilen azalma veya kesilmeyi anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kanal dardır ama süt uğraşla çıkabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kanalın kuruması, bozulması veya kesilmesi yüzünden süt bütünüyle durmuş olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal dişi hayvanın meme kanalı ile süt akışı arasındaki bozukluğu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta daralma akışı güçleştirir ve azaltır; komşuda fiziksel kesilme veya bozulma sütü sona erdirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi taşsız sert toprağı, çeşitli maddelerin sıkılaşıp dağılmaz hale gelmesini ve yağmurun toprağı bastırıp pekiştirmesini ortak sertlik ve kohezyon ekseninde destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Şiddetli yağmurun kendisi değil, zemini bastırıp sıkılaştıran etkisi bu dala girer.

lexicalization_scope.note: Toprak adı yalın bir zemin türünü, eylem biçimleri ise kumun, etin veya toprağın sertleşip sıkılaşmasını bildirir; kapsamlar harmanlanmaz.

concept_map.definition: Toprağın veya başka bir maddenin sert, sıkı ve dağılmaz bir yapıda olması ya da basınç ve yağmur etkisiyle böyle bir yapıya gelmesi.

facets.statement: Taşlı olması gerekmeyen zemin sert ve sıkı bir yapı gösterir.
Kum, et veya başka bir madde sıkılaşıp sertleşerek dağılmaz hale gelir.
Yağmur toprağı bastırıp tanelerini birbirine bağlayarak zemini pekiştirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sertlik ve sıkı tutunma çekirdeğini toprak, kum ve et üzerinde gösterir; yağmur bu niteliğin nedeni olarak zemini bastırıp pekiştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Toprak veya başka bir maddenin sıkı, sert ve dağılmaz hale gelmesini anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sertliği, sıkı tutunmayı ve pekişme sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yağmurun toprağı sıkılaştıran ve yüzeyi daha sert hale getiren etkisini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Yağmuru neden, toprağın sıkılaşmasını sonuç olarak korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: taşsız, sert ve su tutmayan zemin

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yağmurla pekişme, kumun dağılmaz hale gelmesi ve taşsız sert toprak kullanımları bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İçi boş olmama, yoğun taş kütlesi ve yüksek kaba yer kapsamları bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal sert, sıkı ve boşluksuz denebilecek maddesel yapıları anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak tanelerin veya dokunun sıkılaşmasına ve özellikle zemine yönelir; komşu katı kütlenin yoğun ve içsiz yapısını daha geniş kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Taşsız sert zemin yanında kum, et ve yağmurla pekişme uzantıları vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kaba sert toprak yüzeyi ve yüzeyden kopmuş iri toprak parçası bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal sert ve sıkı toprak yüzeyini adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak sertliği taşsızlık ve sıkı tutunmayla tanımlar; komşu zeminin kabalığına ve ondan kopan parçaya da uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sertlik, sıkılık ve dağılmama bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yumuşak toprak veya kara çamur bulunur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak sıkı ve sert ucu, komşu ise yumuşak veya çamurlu ucu temsil eder.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çetin yılı, çok ve şiddetli yağmuru ve baskın seli destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki vadide şiddetli itme unsuru kaynak ifadesinde yer almadığından tanıma alınmamıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal zeminin sertliğini veya yağmurun toprağı pekiştirme etkisini değil, yıl ve yağış olaylarının şiddetini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yıl adı bağımsız bir biçimdir; şiddetli yağmur ve baskın sel anlamları yalnızca kendi ad tamlaması benzeri kalıplarında korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir yılın ağır ve çetin geçmesi, yağmurun çok ve sert yağması ya da selin baskın bir güç taşıması.

facets.statement: Yıl, insanlar ve yaşam koşulları üzerinde ağır baskı yaratacak ölçüde çetindir.
Yağmur çok, sert ve iri damlalı biçimde yağar.
Sel çevresine üstün gelen baskın bir akış gücü taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yılın çetinliği ile yağmur ve selin güçlü şiddetini aynı yoğunluk alanında toplar; her kullanım kendi adlandırma kalıbına bağlıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yılın ağır oluşunu, yağmurun sertliğini ve selin baskın gücünü ortak biçimde özetler.

error_profile.preserves: Çetin yıl, şiddetli yağmur ve baskın sel kapsamlarını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yağmurun miktar ve vuruş bakımından güçlü olduğu özel kalıpta kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yağmur alanını, bolluğu ve yüksek şiddeti birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Selin çevresine üstün gelen baskın akışını anlatan özel kalıpta kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sel olayını ve baskın akış gücünü birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çetin yıl ve baskın sel yanında şiddetli yağmur bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Rüzgar, sıcak ve soğuk gibi başka hava olaylarının şiddetlenmesi de kapsanır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: şiddetli yağış ve hava olayının şiddetlenmesi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yağmurun sertleşip güçlü biçimde gerçekleşmesini anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak belirli yıl, yağmur ve sel adlandırmalarına bağlıdır; komşu çeşitli hava olaylarının oluş sırasında şiddetlenmesini kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çetin yıl ve çok şiddetli yağmur da bağımsız kapsamdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Suyun yükselerek taşması ve önüne kattığını sürüklemesi kurucu özelliktir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal güçlü selin çevresine üstün gelen hareketinde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak seli baskın gücüyle niteler; komşu suyun yükselip taşmasını ve sürükleyici sonucunu ayrıntılandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çok, sert ve güçlü yağış bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalnızca yüzeyi hafifçe ıslatan zayıf yağış bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yağmuru miktar ve etki şiddeti ekseninde niteler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak eksenin yüksek şiddet ucunu, komşu ise düşük şiddet ve yüzeysel ıslatma ucunu temsil eder.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hastalık veya ölümün kişiye üstün gelmesini merkezde tutar, fakat aynı yapıyı başka baskın durumlara, bir işin inatla sürmesine ve ayartıcı gücün kişiye egemen olmasına da genişletir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel iki rakip arasındaki yenme değil, belirli eylem yapısında hastalık, ölüm veya başka bir durumun kişiyi ele geçirmesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam belirli türemiş eylemler ve ağır hastalık kalıbıyla sınırlıdır; hastalık dışı kapsamlar da ancak bu yapılarda geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Hastalık, ölüm veya başka baskın bir durumun kişiyi yenip gücünü kırması; bir işin ya da ayartıcı etkinin kişi üzerinde inatla egemenlik kurması.

facets.statement: Hastalık, ölüm veya başka bir durum kişiye üstün gelerek onu güçsüz bırakır.
Bir iş veya ayartıcı etki kişi üzerinde ısrarla sürer ve onun denetimini aşar.
Kalıp niteleme, hastalığın çok ağır ve şiddetli olduğunu bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar hastalık veya ölüm başta olmak üzere bir durumun kişiye üstün gelmesi çekirdeğinde birleşir; işin sürüp gitmesi ve ayartıcı etkinin egemenliği kapsam uzantılarıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Olumsuzluk, aşağılık veya darlığın bir şeyin üzerine çöküp onu bütünüyle örtmesi belirgindir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi atın sağrı ve uyluk çevresinde, iki arka yan veya kalça ucu arasında yer alan belirli anatomik bölgeyi adlandırır. Kaynaklardaki tarifler aynı arka beden yöresinin yakın sınırlarını verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca at anatomisine ait bir bölge adıdır; manevi güç, saygınlık veya sert zemin anlamı taşımaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kanıt tek bir yalın anatomik adla sınırlıdır; başka beden parçalarına veya mecazi anlamlara genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Atın arka bedeninde, sağrı ile uyluğun birleşimine yakın, iki kalça ucu veya arka yan çıkıntısı arasında kalan bölge.

facets.statement: Bölge atın arka bedeninde sağrı, uyluk ve iki kalça ucu arasındaki yakın alanda bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak tarifleri atın arka bedenindeki aynı bölgeyi, sağrı-uyluk birleşimi ile iki kalça ucu arasındaki yakın anatomik sınırlarla açıklar.

concept_gloss.text: atın iki kalça ucu arasındaki bölge
concept_gloss.applicability: Atın sağrı ve uyluk çevresindeki belirli arka beden bölümünü adlandırmak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvan türünü, arka beden konumunu ve iki yan arasındaki bölgeyi korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: atın sağrı ile uyluk yakınındaki iki kalça ucu arası

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Devenin sağrısı ile uyluğu arasındaki eklem bölgesi adlandırılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal büyük bir binek hayvanının arka bedeninde sağrı ile uyluğa yakın anatomik alanı gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Konumlar yakın olsa da odak atın iki yan arasındaki bölgesine, komşu devenin belirli birleşim yerine bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Atın iki kalça ucu arasındaki dar anatomik bölgeyi gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsan veya hayvanda sağrı, kaba et ve bir şeyin arkası gibi daha geniş arka bölüm anlamlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: belirli kalça aralığı ve genel sağrı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bedenin arka, sağrı ve kalça çevresindeki alanları adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak tür ve konum bakımından dar bir at anatomisi terimidir; komşu genel arka bölüm ve sağrı alanını kapsar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العزيزاء من الفرس وما بين الجاعرتين أو طرفا الورك
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس العزة المعنوية ولا العزاز من الأرض
branches.source_phrase_ar: العزيزاء من الفرس ما بين عكوته وجاعرته (maqayis); العزيزى من الفرس وهما طرفا الوركين (sihah); العزيزاء وهما عزيزاوا الفرس ما بين جاعرتيه (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal, kanıtta tek üretken kök çekirdeğine indirgenmeyen sınırlı adlandırma malzemesini taşır. Yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan, yalnız verilen biçim ve bağlam sınırı içinde kontrollü adlandırma kümesi olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kayıt genel kök anlamı gibi genişletilmemeli, içindeki öğeler birbirinin yerine geçen tek bir sözlük karşılığı sayılmamalı ve yalnız kanıtın verdiği adlandırma sınırı içinde kullanılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim, adlandırma veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kanıt, aynı yazı ailesinde dişil bir üstünlük biçimi ile bundan kavramsal olarak ayrı olan kült, ceylan yavrusu ve kadın adlandırmalarını birlikte sunar.

facets.statement: Bir biçim, en güçlü veya en üstün anlamındaki sıfatın dişil karşılığıdır.
Aynı biçim ayrıca tapınılan bir putun veya ağacın özel adı olarak aktarılır.
Başka bir sesletim ceylan yavrusunu ve bundan türeyen kadın adını bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, tek bir birleşik anlamdan çok sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırmaları gösterir; dal bu kayıtları kontrollü biçimde görünür tutar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bu karşılık, kanıttaki sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırma kümesini güvenli biçimde etiketler; tek ve birleşik bir sözlük anlamı değildir.

error_profile.preserves: Dalın özel, yalıtık veya biçime bağlı adlandırma niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Tek tek kullanımların özel göndergelerini kavram karşılığının içine ayrı ayrı taşımaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynaklı ifade, keçiyi belirli bir ünlemle azarlayıp sürme sesini ve bu sesle yapılan kovma eylemini açıkça aynı sözlü yönlendirme kullanımında birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal güç, saygınlık veya yenme anlamı taşımaz; yalnızca keçiye yöneltilen belirli kovma ünlemi ve bundan kurulan eylemdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam bir sesleniş kalıbı ve ondan kurulan tekrar biçimli eylemle sınırlıdır; yalın köke bağımsız bir kovma anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: Keçiyi uzaklaştırmak veya yönlendirmek için ona belirli bir kovma ünlemi söylemek ve bu seslenişle hayvanı sürmek.

facets.statement: Konuşan, keçiyi kovmak veya yönlendirmek amacıyla belirli bir ünlem çıkarır.
Tekrarlı eylem biçimi, keçiyi bu ünlemle azarlayıp sürme işlemini bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek tanıklık, keçiye yöneltilen kovma ünlemiyle bu ünlemi söyleyerek hayvanı sürme eylemini birlikte kaydeder.

source_details.summary: Keçiye özgü kovma ünlemi ve ondan kurulan sürme eylemi yalnızca bu tanıklıkta yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Keçiye belirli bir ses çıkararak onu uzaklaştırma veya yönlendirme eylemini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvan türünü, ünlem kullanımını ve sürme amacını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ünlemin kendisi yerine yapılan eylemin doğal Türkçe açıklamasının gerektiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kovma sesini, keçiyi ve uzaklaştırma eylemini açıkça korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir ünlemle özellikle keçiyi kovma eylemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Başka bir seslenişle keçi veya koyunu çağırma ve azarlama kapsamı vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal küçükbaş hayvana seslenerek onu çağırma, sürme veya azarlama işlevinde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: İşlevler yakın olsa da odak yalnızca keçiye yöneltilen kendi kovma ünlemine, komşu ise farklı bir ses ve daha geniş hayvan kapsamına bağlıdır.
